source_documents.title: Multifunctional AIE-ESIPT dual mechanism tetraphenylethene-based Schiff base for inkless rewritable paper and colorimetric/fluorescent dual-channel Zn2+ sensor

reference_evidence_units.quote: The 410 nm emission band is attributed to the enol form of TPESB
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF absorption and PL; main-text report of SI S1-S2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign bands near 410 and 590 nm to enol and ESIPT keto forms; absorption maximum is near 325 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Steady-state assignment, not time-resolved proof of proton transfer; spectra cited in SI were not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the weak emission was significantly increased (about 10 times).
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fresh THF/water mixtures; 90% water, SI S3 as reported in main text.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Freshly prepared 90% water mixtures have about tenfold emission enhancement over THF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI plot not inspected; distinguish this immediate AIE test from time-dependent low-water aging.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The initially colourless solution gradually changed into obviously yellow
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 1 on p.3: 1e-5 M, excitation 365 nm, water/THF mixtures followed with time.
reference_evidence_units.statement: At 10% water a 400-500 nm absorption band grows and weak red emission becomes intense yellow. Similar aging occurs at 1-30%, but not at 50-90% water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Aging conditions matter; absence of further time-dependent enhancement at high water does not negate immediate AIE.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the photoinduced electron transfer (PET) effect can significantly quench the emission of TPESB.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute weak emission partly to PET and propose that hydrogen bonding with added water restricts PET.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Tentative mechanistic assignment; broadened NMR signals reported from SI S5 demonstrate interactions, not an independently resolved PET rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: addition of water may lead to formation of aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Low-water aging; Fig. 1 scattering plus reported SI SEM, precipitation and lifetime controls.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose aggregate-induced RIR suppresses nonradiative loss. At high water, immediate tightly packed nanoparticles are proposed to limit further water interaction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SEM and lifetime SI not inspected; no quantitative torsional barrier or independent radiative/nonradiative rates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PEG can passivate the hydroxyl groups of paper
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB in PEG/paper
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Three-layer rewritable paper; water writing and drying, Fig. 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: PEG is proposed to prevent microcrystalline aggregates and promote water access; water-written fluorescence can be erased by drying and cycled ten times.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This matrix application is not evidence that PEG simply rigidifies the dye; its reported function includes suppressing aggregates and swelling.

reference_evidence_units.quote: blue-shifted to 550 nm after addition of Zn2+
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB with zinc
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 1e-5 M in THF/water 1:1, excitation 365 nm; Figs. 4-5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Zn2+ rapidly enhances fluorescence and shifts the weak approximately 600 nm band toward 550 nm, with a new approximately 490 nm absorption band; tested competing ions show only slight changes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Selectivity is limited to tested ions and conditions; zinc response is not simply solvent-driven aggregation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The chelation effect will restrict the PET effect and prevent the ESIPT
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB with zinc
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Binding model supported by main-text accounts of Job plot, MS, NMR and FTIR, SI S15-S19.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose 1:1 Zn coordination involving phenolic oxygens and imine nitrogens; this suppresses PET, ESIPT and nonradiative decay to explain enhanced blue-shifted fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: All detailed binding controls are SI reported in main, not independently inspected. Zinc binding does not establish metal-centered or triplet emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: decrease of the HOMO-LUMO energy gap of zinc complex of TPESB
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPESB and zinc complex
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated complex gap is lower than free TPESB, used to rationalize the new absorption band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Orbital gap alone does not prove an emissive CT state, PET rate or the observed blue shift.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit aggregate-induced RIR interpretation is retained with its tentative language and indirect controls.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregate packing and matrix-dependent water access modulate emission; this is enabling environment, not a universal PEG-rigidification claim.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Under the frozen analyte-binding definition, zinc chelation changes target emission. This is molecular coordination, not macrocycle inclusion.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Authors assign free-dye keto emission to ESIPT and propose its suppression upon zinc binding; preserve both states.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keep the explicit but incompletely proven PET-quenching/suppression interpretation rather than discarding it for lack of direct kinetics.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV

mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregate packing and matrix-dependent water access modulate emission; this is enabling environment, not a universal PEG-rigidification claim.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Under the frozen analyte-binding definition, zinc chelation changes target emission. This is molecular coordination, not macrocycle inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Calculated frontier-gap reduction is not sufficient to establish CT-emission or TICT control.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Authors assign free-dye keto emission to ESIPT and propose its suppression upon zinc binding; preserve both states.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Keep the explicit but incompletely proven PET-quenching/suppression interpretation rather than discarding it for lack of direct kinetics.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific exciton, excimer or new intermolecular emissive state is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or state-population explanation is established; intensity or lifetime changes alone do not isolate it.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet or metal/energy-transfer photophysics is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established in this extraction.
